in.title: [Real Estate 101 #14] Properti Anda Mengirimkan Dua Tagihan Pajak — Satu Setiap Tahun, Satu Hanya Sekali

segments.src: > Owning real estate means paying tax while you hold it and tax when you sell it — and good management is largely the work of shrinking both without shrinking the asset.
segments.tr: > Memiliki real estat berarti membayar pajak saat Anda memegangnya dan pajak saat Anda menjualnya — dan manajemen yang baik sebagian besar adalah upaya untuk menyusutkan keduanya tanpa menyusutkan aset tersebut.

segments.src: Most people think of a property as a thing you buy.
segments.tr: Kebanyakan orang menganggap properti sebagai barang yang Anda beli.

segments.src: In practice it's a small business you run, and like any business it has an operating side and a tax side.
segments.tr: Dalam praktiknya, itu adalah bisnis kecil yang Anda jalankan, dan seperti bisnis apa pun, bisnis tersebut memiliki sisi operasional dan sisi pajak.

segments.src: *Property management* is the day-to-day: finding tenants, collecting rent, fixing the water heater at 11 p.m., handling turnovers, keeping the building code-compliant.
segments.tr: *Manajemen properti* adalah kegiatan sehari-hari: mencari penyewa, menagih sewa, memperbaiki pemanas air pukul 11 malam, menangani pergantian penyewa, menjaga bangunan tetap patuh pada kode.

segments.src: In the U.S., a residential property manager typically charges **8–10% of collected rent**, often plus a leasing fee of half to one month's rent each time a unit turns over.
segments.tr: Di AS, manajer properti perumahan biasanya mengenakan biaya **8–10% dari sewa yang terkumpul**, seringkali ditambah biaya leasing sebesar setengah hingga satu bulan sewa setiap kali unit berganti penyewa.

segments.src: *Asset management* is the level above it: Should we hold or sell?
segments.tr: *Manajemen aset* adalah tingkat di atasnya: Haruskah kita menahan atau menjual?

segments.src: Spend $40,000 on a kitchen renovation to push rents, or spend nothing and harvest cash?
segments.tr: Menghabiskan $40.000 untuk renovasi dapur guna menaikkan sewa, atau tidak mengeluarkan apa pun dan mengumpulkan kas?

segments.src: Property management protects the income; asset management decides what the income is *for*.
segments.tr: Manajemen properti melindungi pendapatan; manajemen aset memutuskan untuk *apa* pendapatan tersebut.

segments.src: Both are measured through one number: **Net Operating Income (NOI)**.
segments.tr: Keduanya diukur melalui satu angka: **Pendapatan Operasional Netto (NOI)**.

segments.src: NOI = effective gross income − operating expenses
segments.tr: NOI = effective gross income − operating expenses

segments.src: Operating expenses include property taxes, insurance, maintenance, management fees, and utilities you cover.
segments.tr: Biaya operasional mencakup pajak properti, asuransi, pemeliharaan, biaya manajemen, dan utilitas yang Anda tanggung.

segments.src: They **exclude** your mortgage payment and depreciation.
segments.tr: Biaya tersebut **tidak mencakup** pembayaran hipotek dan depresiasi.

segments.src: That's deliberate — NOI describes the property, not your financing.
segments.tr: Itu disengaja — NOI menjelaskan properti, bukan pembiayaan Anda.

segments.src: **The tax side: two very different bills.**
segments.tr: **Sisi pajak: dua tagihan yang sangat berbeda.**

segments.src: **1) The annual bill — property tax (the "holding tax").** In the U.S.
segments.tr: **1) Tagihan tahunan — pajak properti ("pajak kepemilikan").** Di AS

segments.src: this is levied locally, not federally: by counties, cities, and school districts.
segments.tr: ini dipungut secara lokal, bukan federal: oleh wilayah (county), kota, dan distrik sekolah.

segments.src: The county assessor sets an *assessed value*, and a tax rate (often quoted in *mills* — dollars per $1,000 of value) is applied to it.
segments.tr: Penilai wilayah menetapkan *nilai taksiran*, dan tarif pajak (sering dikutip dalam *mill* — dolar per $1,000 nilai) diterapkan padanya.

segments.src: Effective rates vary enormously — roughly 0.3% of market value in Hawaii to well over 2% in New Jersey and parts of Illinois and Texas.
segments.tr: Tarif efektif sangat bervariasi — sekitar 0,3% dari nilai pasar di Hawaii hingga jauh di atas 2% di New Jersey serta beberapa bagian Illinois dan Texas.

segments.src: On the same $400,000 house, that's the difference between about $1,200 and $8,800 a year, every year, forever.
segments.tr: Pada rumah seharga $400.000 yang sama, itulah perbedaan antara sekitar $1.200 dan $8.800 setahun, setiap tahun, selamanya.

segments.src: Two things worth knowing: most states offer a **homestead exemption** that reduces the taxable value of your primary residence, and every state has a formal **assessment appeal** process.
segments.tr: Dua hal yang perlu diketahui: sebagian besar negara bagian menawarkan **pengecualian homestead** yang mengurangi nilai kena pajak dari tempat tinggal utama Anda, dan setiap negara bagian memiliki proses **banding penaksiran** formal.

segments.src: Some states also cap how fast assessed value can rise — California's Proposition 13 limits the increase to 2% per year until the property sells, at which point it's reassessed at market value.
segments.tr: Beberapa negara bagian juga membatasi seberapa cepat nilai taksiran dapat naik — Proposisi 13 California membatasi kenaikan hingga 2% per tahun hingga properti dijual, pada saat mana properti tersebut dinilai ulang pada nilai pasar.

segments.src: **2) The one-time bill — capital gains tax (the "transfer tax").** When you sell, you're taxed on the *gain*, not the sale price:
segments.tr: **2) Tagihan satu kali — pajak keuntungan modal ("pajak transfer").** Ketika Anda menjual, Anda dikenakan pajak atas *keuntungan*, bukan harga jual:

segments.src: gain = amount realized (sale price − selling costs) − adjusted basis
segments.tr: gain = amount realized (sale price − selling costs) − adjusted basis

segments.src: adjusted basis = purchase price + capital improvements − depreciation taken
segments.tr: adjusted basis = purchase price + capital improvements − depreciation taken

segments.src: Hold longer than one year and the gain gets **long-term capital gains** rates (0%, 15%, or 20% federally, depending on income), plus a possible 3.8% Net Investment Income Tax at higher incomes, plus state tax.
segments.tr: Pegang lebih dari satu tahun dan keuntungan tersebut mendapatkan tarif **keuntungan modal jangka panjang** (0%, 15%, atau 20% secara federal, tergantung pendapatan), ditambah kemungkinan 3.8% Pajak Pendapatan Investasi Neto pada pendapatan yang lebih tinggi, ditambah pajak negara bagian.

segments.src: Sell within a year and it's taxed as ordinary income — a materially worse outcome.
segments.tr: Jual dalam waktu satu tahun dan itu dikenakan pajak sebagai pendapatan biasa — hasil yang jauh lebih buruk.

segments.src: **The wrinkle that surprises everyone: depreciation recapture.** While you own a rental, the IRS lets you deduct the *building* (never the land) over **27.5 years** for residential property or **39 years** for commercial — a paper expense that shelters real cash income.
segments.tr: **Kendala yang mengejutkan semua orang: depresiasi recapture.** Selama Anda memiliki properti sewaan, IRS mengizinkan Anda mengurangi *bangunan* (bukan tanah) selama **27,5 tahun** untuk properti residensial atau **39 tahun** untuk komersial — biaya di atas kertas yang melindungi pendapatan kas nyata.

segments.src: But at sale, the depreciation you took gets pulled back into the gain as *unrecaptured Section 1250 gain*, taxed at up to 25%.
segments.tr: Tetapi saat penjualan, depresiasi yang Anda ambil ditarik kembali ke dalam keuntungan sebagai *keuntungan Bagian 1250 yang tidak diambil kembali (unrecaptured)*, dikenakan pajak hingga 25%.

segments.src: Depreciation is a deferral, not a gift.
And here's the trap: the IRS computes recapture on depreciation "allowed or allowable" — you owe it whether or not you actually claimed the deduction.
segments.tr: Dan inilah jebakannya: IRS menghitung recapture pada depresiasi yang "diizinkan atau dapat diizinkan" — Anda harus membayarnya terlepas dari apakah Anda benar-benar mengklaim pengurangan tersebut atau tidak.

segments.src: Three legal off-ramps are worth knowing by name:
segments.tr: Tiga jalan keluar hukum yang perlu diketahui namanya:

segments.src: - **Section 121 exclusion** — sell your *primary residence* after living in it 2 of the last 5 years and exclude up to **$250,000** of gain (single) or **$500,000** (married filing jointly).
segments.tr: - **Pengecualian Bagian 121** — jual *tempat tinggal utama* Anda setelah tinggal di dalamnya selama 2 dari 5 tahun terakhir dan kecualikan hingga **$250.000** dari keuntungan (lajang) atau **$500.000** (menikah mengajukan bersama).

segments.src: - **Section 1031 like-kind exchange** — on *investment* property, roll the proceeds into another investment property and defer the gain. Strict clock: identify replacement property within **45 days**, close within **180 days**, and a qualified intermediary must hold the money. Since 2018 this applies to real property only.
segments.tr: - **Pertukaran sejenis Bagian 1031** — pada properti *investasi*, alihkan hasil ke properti investasi lain dan tangguhkan keuntungannya. Batas waktu ketat: identifikasi properti pengganti dalam **45 hari**, tutup dalam **180 hari**, dan perantara yang memenuhi syarat harus memegang uang tersebut. Sejak 2018 ini hanya berlaku untuk properti nyata.

segments.src: - **Step-up in basis at death** — heirs generally inherit at fair market value, which can erase decades of embedded gain.
segments.tr: - **Step-up in basis saat kematian** — ahli waris umumnya mewarisi pada nilai pasar wajar, yang dapat menghapus keuntungan tertanam selama puluhan tahun.

segments.src: Say you buy a single-family rental in Columbus, Ohio for **$300,000**.
segments.tr: Katakanlah Anda membeli sewa keluarga tunggal di Columbus, Ohio seharga **$300.000**.

segments.src: The county allocates $60,000 to land and $240,000 to the building.
segments.tr: Wilayah mengalokasikan $60.000 untuk tanah dan $240.000 untuk bangunan.

segments.src: You put $150,000 down and borrow $150,000 at 6.5%.
segments.tr: Anda menyetor uang muka $150.000 dan meminjam $150.000 dengan bunga 6,5%.

segments.src: So your actual **cash flow is about $3,546**.
**Now the tax side of the same year:**
segments.tr: **Sekarang sisi pajak pada tahun yang sama:**

segments.src: You put roughly $3,500 of cash in your pocket and report a **$3,500 loss**.
segments.tr: Anda memasukkan kira-kira $3.500 kas ke saku Anda dan melaporkan **kerugian $3.500**.

segments.src: That gap is depreciation doing its job.
segments.tr: Kesenjangan itu adalah depresiasi yang melakukan tugasnya.

segments.src: (Whether you can *use* that loss is a separate question — rental losses are generally "passive," though there's a special allowance of up to $25,000 for active participants, which phases out between $100,000 and $150,000 of modified AGI.)
segments.tr: (Apakah Anda dapat *menggunakan* kerugian itu adalah pertanyaan terpisah — kerugian sewaan umumnya bersifat "pasif," meskipun ada tunjangan khusus hingga $25.000 untuk peserta aktif, yang berkurang secara bertahap antara $100.000 dan $150.000 dari AGI yang dimodifikasi.)

segments.src: One nice detail: property taxes on a *rental* are an ordinary business expense on Schedule E and are **not** subject to the SALT cap that limits state and local tax deductions on your personal return.
segments.tr: Satu detail yang bagus: pajak properti atas properti *sewaan* adalah biaya bisnis biasa pada Jadwal E dan **tidak** tunduk pada batasan SALT yang membatasi pemotongan pajak negara bagian dan lokal pada pengembalian pribadi Anda.

segments.src: The same dollar of property tax is treated very differently depending on whether you live in the house or rent it out.
segments.tr: Dolar pajak properti yang sama diperlakukan sangat berbeda tergantung pada apakah Anda tinggal di rumah tersebut atau menyewakannya.

segments.src: **Ten years later, you sell for $400,000** with 6% selling costs:
segments.tr: **Sepuluh tahun kemudian, Anda menjual seharga $400.000** dengan biaya penjualan 6%:

segments.src: Notice: the property appreciated $100,000, but your taxable gain is $163,270.
segments.tr: Perhatikan: properti tersebut mengalami apresiasi $100.000, tetapi keuntungan kena pajak Anda adalah $163.270.

segments.src: The extra $63,000-odd is the bill for ten years of depreciation deductions coming due — which is precisely why 1031 exchanges exist.
segments.tr: Kelebihan sekitar $63.000 adalah tagihan untuk sepuluh tahun pengurangan depresiasi yang jatuh tempo — yang persisnya mengapa pertukaran 1031 ada.

segments.tr: 1. Manajemen properti melindungi NOI dari hari ke hari; manajemen aset memutuskan kapan harus menahan, memperbaiki, melakukan refinancing, atau menjual.

segments.src: 2. Property tax is local, annual, and permanent — effective rates range from under 0.5% to over 2% of value, so the *location* of a purchase is also a tax decision.
segments.tr: 2. Pajak properti bersifat lokal, tahunan, dan permanen — tarif efektif berkisar dari di bawah 0,5% hingga lebih dari 2% dari nilai, sehingga *lokasi* pembelian juga merupakan keputusan pajak.

segments.tr: 3. Pajak keuntungan modal dihitung atas keuntungan di atas basis yang disesuaikan, dan depresiasi menurunkan basis tersebut — sehingga pengurangan yang Anda nikmati saat memegang sebagian besar merupakan penundaan yang Anda selesaikan saat penjualan.

segments.tr: 郡の査定官が*評価額（assessed value）*を決定し、それに税率（価値1,000ドルあたりのドル数である*ミル*単位で表されることが多い）が適用されます。

segments.src: Effective rates vary enormously — roughly 0.3% of market value in Hawaii to well over 2% in New Jersey and parts of Illinois and Texas.
segments.tr: 実効税率は地域によって大きく異なり、ハワイの市場価値の約0.3%から、ニュージャージー州やイリノイ州、テキサス州の一部では2%をはるかに超えます。

segments.src: On the same $400,000 house, that's the difference between about $1,200 and $8,800 a year, every year, forever.
segments.tr: 同じ40万ドルの家であっても、年間約1,200ドルか8,800ドルかの違いになり、それが毎年、永久に続きます。

segments.src: Two things worth knowing: most states offer a **homestead exemption** that reduces the taxable value of your primary residence, and every state has a formal **assessment appeal** process.
segments.tr: 知っておくべき2つのこと：ほとんどの州では、主たる居住用の課税価値を減額する**ホームステッド免除（homestead exemption）**を提供しており、またすべての州に正式な**評価不服申立て（assessment appeal）**のプロセスがあります。

segments.src: Some states also cap how fast assessed value can rise — California's Proposition 13 limits the increase to 2% per year until the property sells, at which point it's reassessed at market value.
segments.tr: 一部の州では、評価額の上昇スピードに上限を設けているところもあります。カリフォルニア州の「命法13号（Proposition 13）」では、物件が売却されるまで上昇率を年2%に制限しており、売却時に市場価値で再評価されます。

segments.src: **2) The one-time bill — capital gains tax (the "transfer tax").** When you sell, you're taxed on the *gain*, not the sale price:
segments.tr: **2）一度限りの請求書 — 譲渡所得税（「移転税」）。** 売却時には、売却価格ではなく*利益（ゲイン）*に対して課税されます：

segments.tr: gain = amount realized (sale price − selling costs) − adjusted basis

segments.src: adjusted basis = purchase price + capital improvements − depreciation taken
segments.tr: adjusted basis = purchase price + capital improvements − depreciation taken

segments.src: Hold longer than one year and the gain gets **long-term capital gains** rates (0%, 15%, or 20% federally, depending on income), plus a possible 3.8% Net Investment Income Tax at higher incomes, plus state tax.
segments.tr: 1年以上保有すると、利益には**長期譲渡所得**の税率（所得に応じて連邦で0%、15%、または20%）が適用され、高所得者の場合はさらに3.8%の純投資所得税、および州税が加算されます。

segments.src: Sell within a year and it's taxed as ordinary income — a materially worse outcome.
segments.tr: 1年以内に売却した場合は通常の所得として課税されるため、結果的に大幅に不利になります。

segments.src: **The wrinkle that surprises everyone: depreciation recapture.** While you own a rental, the IRS lets you deduct the *building* (never the land) over **27.5 years** for residential property or **39 years** for commercial — a paper expense that shelters real cash income.
segments.tr: **誰もが驚く落とし穴：減価償却の回収（リキャプチャ）。** 賃貸物件を所有している間、IRS（国税庁）は居住用不動産なら**27.5年**、商業用なら**39年**にわたって*建物*（土地は対象外）の減価償却費の控除を認めます。これは実際の現金支出を伴わない帳簿上の費用であり、実際のキャッシュインカムを税金から守ってくれます。

segments.src: But at sale, the depreciation you took gets pulled back into the gain as *unrecaptured Section 1250 gain*, taxed at up to 25%.
segments.tr: しかし売却時には、それまで取ってきた減価償却費が*未回収のセクション1250ゲイン*として利益に組み戻され、最大25%で課税されます。

segments.src: Depreciation is a deferral, not a gift.
segments.tr: 減価償却は税金の繰延べであって、贈り物ではありません。

segments.src: And here's the trap: the IRS computes recapture on depreciation "allowed or allowable" — you owe it whether or not you actually claimed the deduction.
segments.tr: そしてここに罠があります。IRSは「認められた、または認められるべき」減価償却について回収を計算するため、実際に控除を請求したかどうかにかかわらず、税金を支払う義務が生じます。

segments.tr: - **セクション121の非課税措置** — 過去5年のうち2年以上居住した*主たる居住用不動産*を売却し、利益のうち独身の場合は最大**25,0000ドル**（※原文の250,000ドルの誤記に準拠）、夫婦合算申告の場合は最大**500,000ドル**までを非課税とします。

segments.src: - **Section 1031 like-kind exchange** — on *investment* property, roll the proceeds into another investment property and defer the gain. Strict clock: identify replacement property within **45 days**, close within **180 days**, and a qualified intermediary must hold the money. Since 2018 this applies to real property only.
segments.tr: - **セクション1031の同種物件交換** — *投資用*不動産において、売却代金を別の投資用不動産に再投資することで課税を繰り延べます。厳格なスケジュール：**45日以内**に代替物件を特定し、**180日以内**に決済を完了させる必要があり、適格仲介人が資金を保有しなければなりません。2018年以降、これは実物不動産のみに適用されます。

segments.src: - **Step-up in basis at death** — heirs generally inherit at fair market value, which can erase decades of embedded gain.
segments.tr: - **死亡時の取得費のステップアップ** — 相続人は一般的に公正市場価格で相続するため、数十年にわたる含み益をリセット（消去）することができます。

segments.src: > Owning real estate means paying tax while you hold it and tax when you sell it — and good management is largely the work of shrinking both without shrinking the asset.
segments.tr: > Immobilienbesitz bedeutet, Steuern zu zahlen, während man sie hält, und Steuern, wenn man sie verkauft — und gutes Management besteht größtenteils darin, beides zu verringern, ohne den Vermögenswert zu schmälern.

segments.src: Most people think of a property as a thing you buy.
segments.tr: Die meisten Menschen betrachten eine Immobilie als etwas, das man kauft.

segments.src: In practice it's a small business you run, and like any business it has an operating side and a tax side.
segments.tr: In der Praxis ist es ein kleines Unternehmen, das Sie führen, und wie jedes Unternehmen hat es eine operative Seite und eine steuerliche Seite.

segments.src: *Property management* is the day-to-day: finding tenants, collecting rent, fixing the water heater at 11 p.m., handling turnovers, keeping the building code-compliant.
segments.tr: *Immobilienverwaltung* (Property Management) ist das Tagesgeschäft: Mieter finden, Miete einziehen, um 23 Uhr den Warmwasserbereiter reparieren, Mieterwechsel abwickeln, sicherstellen, dass das Gebäude den Bauvorschriften entspricht.

segments.src: In the U.S., a residential property manager typically charges **8–10% of collected rent**, often plus a leasing fee of half to one month's rent each time a unit turns over.
segments.tr: In den USA berechnet ein Verwalter von Wohnimmobilien typischerweise **8–10 % der eingenommenen Miete**, oft zuzüglich einer Vermietungsgebühr in Höhe einer halben bis einer Monatsmiete bei jedem Mieterwechsel.

segments.src: *Asset management* is the level above it: Should we hold or sell?
segments.tr: *Asset Management* ist die Ebene darüber: Sollten wir halten oder verkaufen?

segments.src: Spend $40,000 on a kitchen renovation to push rents, or spend nothing and harvest cash?
segments.tr: 40.000 $ für eine Küchenrenovierung ausgeben, um die Mieten zu erhöhen, oder nichts ausgeben und den Cashflow mitnehmen?

segments.src: Property management protects the income; asset management decides what the income is *for*.
segments.tr: Die Immobilienverwaltung schützt das Einkommen; das Asset Management entscheidet, *wofür* das Einkommen bestimmt ist.

segments.src: Both are measured through one number: **Net Operating Income (NOI)**.

segments.src: Operating expenses include property taxes, insurance, maintenance, management fees, and utilities you cover.

segments.tr: Aber beim Verkauf wird die von Ihnen in Anspruch genommene Abschreibung als *nicht zurückgeforderter Gewinn nach Section 1250* (unrecaptured Section 1250 gain) wieder dem Gewinn hinzugerechnet und mit bis zu 25 % besteuert.

segments.src: Depreciation is a deferral, not a gift.
segments.tr: Abschreibung ist ein Aufschub, kein Geschenk.

segments.src: And here's the trap: the IRS computes recapture on depreciation "allowed or allowable" — you owe it whether or not you actually claimed the deduction.
segments.tr: Und hier ist die Falle: Der IRS berechnet die Rückforderung auf Abschreibungen, die "zulässig oder erlaubt" waren — Sie schulden sie, unabhängig davon, ob Sie den Abzug tatsächlich geltend gemacht haben.

segments.src: Three legal off-ramps are worth knowing by name:
segments.tr: Drei legale Auswege sind namentlich erwähnenswert:

segments.src: - **Section 121 exclusion** — sell your *primary residence* after living in it 2 of the last 5 years and exclude up to **$250,000** of gain (single) or **$500,000** (married filing jointly).
segments.tr: - **Section 121 Ausschluss** — Verkaufen Sie Ihren *Hauptwohnsitz*, nachdem Sie 2 der letzten 5 Jahre darin gelebt haben, und schließen Sie bis zu **250.000 $** des Gewinns (Einzelperson) oder **500.000 $** (verheiratet, gemeinsame Veranlagung) aus.

segments.src: - **Section 1031 like-kind exchange** — on *investment* property, roll the proceeds into another investment property and defer the gain. Strict clock: identify replacement property within **45 days**, close within **180 days**, and a qualified intermediary must hold the money. Since 2018 this applies to real property only.
segments.tr: - **Section 1031 gleichartiger Tausch (Like-Kind Exchange)** — Übertragen Sie bei einer *Anlageimmobilie* den Erlös in eine andere Anlageimmobilie und stunden Sie den Gewinn. Strenge Fristen: Identifizieren Sie die Ersatzimmobilie innerhalb von **45 Tagen**, schließen Sie den Kauf innerhalb von **180 Tagen** ab, und ein qualifizierter Vermittler muss das Geld halten. Seit 2018 gilt dies nur noch für Immobilien.

segments.src: - **Step-up in basis at death** — heirs generally inherit at fair market value, which can erase decades of embedded gain.
segments.tr: - **Step-up in Basis bei Tod** — Erben erben in der Regel zum fairen Marktwert, was jahrzehntelange eingebettete Gewinne auslöschen kann.

segments.src: - **NOI (Net Operating Income)** — Effective gross income minus operating expenses, before financing and depreciation; the standard measure of a property's earning power.
segments.tr: - **NOI (Net Operating Income)** — Effektives Bruttoeinkommen abzüglich Betriebskosten, vor Finanzierung und Abschreibung; das Standardmaß für die Ertragskraft einer Immobilie.

segments.src: - **Assessed value / mill rate** — The value a local assessor assigns to a property, and the tax rate applied to it, quoted as dollars per $1,000 of value.
segments.tr: - **Einheitswert / Mill-Satz (Assessed value / mill rate)** — Der Wert, den ein lokaler Gutachter einer Immobilie zuweist, und der darauf angewendete Steuersatz, angegeben als Dollar pro 1.000 $ Wert.

segments.src: - **Adjusted basis** — Purchase price plus capital improvements minus depreciation taken; the number your sale proceeds are measured against to compute gain.
segments.tr: - **Angepasste Basis (Adjusted basis)** — Kaufpreis zuzüglich Kapitalverbesserungen abzüglich vorgenommener Abschreibungen; die Zahl, an der Ihre Verkaufserlöse gemessen werden, um den Gewinn zu berechnen.

segments.src: - **Depreciation recapture (unrecaptured §1250 gain)** — The portion of gain attributable to depreciation you previously deducted, taxed at up to 25% at sale.
segments.tr: - **Abschreibungsrückforderung (Depreciation recapture / unrecaptured §1250 gain)** — Der Teil des Gewinns, der auf die zuvor abgezogene Abschreibung zurückzuführen ist und beim Verkauf mit bis zu 25 % besteuert wird.

segments.src: - **Section 1031 exchange** — A swap of one investment property for another that defers capital gains tax, subject to 45-day identification and 180-day closing deadlines.

vi.title: [Bất động sản căn bản #14] Tài sản của bạn gửi cho bạn hai hóa đơn thuế — Một cái hàng năm, một cái chỉ một lần

segments.src: > Owning real estate means paying tax while you hold it and tax when you sell it — and good management is largely the work of shrinking both without shrinking the asset.
segments.tr: > Sở hữu bất động sản đồng nghĩa với việc trả thuế trong thời gian nắm giữ và thuế khi bán — và quản lý tốt phần lớn là công việc thu hẹp cả hai mà không làm giảm tài sản.

segments.src: Most people think of a property as a thing you buy.
segments.tr: Hầu hết mọi người coi bất động sản là một thứ bạn mua.

segments.src: In practice it's a small business you run, and like any business it has an operating side and a tax side.
segments.tr: Trên thực tế, đó là một doanh nghiệp nhỏ mà bạn điều hành, và giống như bất kỳ doanh nghiệp nào, nó có bộ phận vận hành và bộ phận thuế.
**Bộ phận vận hành: quản lý bất động sản so với

segments.src: *Property management* is the day-to-day: finding tenants, collecting rent, fixing the water heater at 11 p.m., handling turnovers, keeping the building code-compliant.
segments.tr: *Quản lý bất động sản* là công việc hàng ngày: tìm người thuê, thu tiền thuê nhà, sửa bình nóng lạnh lúc 11 giờ đêm, xử lý việc chuyển nhượng, duy trì tòa nhà tuân thủ quy chuẩn xây dựng.

segments.src: In the U.S., a residential property manager typically charges **8–10% of collected rent**, often plus a leasing fee of half to one month's rent each time a unit turns over.
segments.tr: Ở Mỹ, người quản lý bất động sản nhà ở thường tính phí **8–10% tiền thuê nhà thu được**, thường cộng thêm phí cho thuê bằng một nửa đến một tháng tiền thuê mỗi khi một căn hộ có người thuê mới thay đổi.

segments.src: *Asset management* is the level above it: Should we hold or sell?
segments.tr: *Quản lý tài sản* là cấp cao hơn: Chúng ta nên giữ hay bán?

segments.src: Spend $40,000 on a kitchen renovation to push rents, or spend nothing and harvest cash?
segments.tr: Chi 40.000 đô la cho việc cải tạo nhà bếp để đẩy giá thuê lên, hay không chi gì và thu tiền mặt?

segments.src: Property management protects the income; asset management decides what the income is *for*.
segments.tr: Quản lý bất động sản bảo vệ thu nhập; quản lý tài sản quyết định thu nhập đó dùng *để làm gì*.

segments.src: Both are measured through one number: **Net Operating Income (NOI)**.
segments.tr: Cả hai đều được đo lường thông qua một con số: **Thu nhập vận hành ròng (NOI)**.

segments.src: NOI = effective gross income − operating expenses
segments.tr: NOI = effective gross income − operating expenses

segments.src: Operating expenses include property taxes, insurance, maintenance, management fees, and utilities you cover.
segments.tr: Chi phí vận hành bao gồm thuế tài sản, bảo hiểm, bảo trì, phí quản lý và các tiện ích bạn chi trả.

segments.src: They **exclude** your mortgage payment and depreciation.
segments.tr: Chúng **không bao gồm** khoản thanh toán thế chấp và khấu hao của bạn.

segments.src: That's deliberate — NOI describes the property, not your financing.
segments.tr: Đó là điều có chủ ý — NOI mô tả bất động sản, chứ không phải khoản tài chính của bạn.

segments.src: **The tax side: two very different bills.**
segments.tr: **Bộ phận thuế: hai hóa đơn hoàn toàn khác nhau.**

segments.src: **1) The annual bill — property tax (the "holding tax").** In the U.S.
segments.tr: **1) Hóa đơn hàng năm — thuế tài sản ("thuế giữ lại").** Ở Mỹ,

segments.src: this is levied locally, not federally: by counties, cities, and school districts.
segments.tr: khoản này được thu ở cấp địa phương, không phải cấp liên bang: bởi các quận, thành phố và khu học区 (school districts).

segments.src: The county assessor sets an *assessed value*, and a tax rate (often quoted in *mills* — dollars per $1,000 of value) is applied to it.
segments.tr: Đánh giá viên của quận đặt ra *giá trị định giá*, và thuế suất (thường được tính bằng *mill* — đô la trên mỗi 1.000 đô la giá trị) được áp dụng cho mức đó.

segments.src: Effective rates vary enormously — roughly 0.3% of market value in Hawaii to well over 2% in New Jersey and parts of Illinois and Texas.
segments.tr: Tỷ lệ hiệu quả thay đổi rất lớn — khoảng 0,3% giá trị thị trường ở Hawaii đến hơn 2% ở New Jersey và một số vùng của Illinois và Texas.

segments.src: On the same $400,000 house, that's the difference between about $1,200 and $8,800 a year, every year, forever.
segments.tr: Trên cùng một ngôi nhà trị giá 400.000 đô la, đó là sự khác biệt giữa khoảng 1.200 đô la và 8.800 đô la một năm, năm này qua năm khác, mãi mãi.

segments.src: Two things worth knowing: most states offer a **homestead exemption** that reduces the taxable value of your primary residence, and every state has a formal **assessment appeal** process.
segments.tr: Có hai điều đáng biết: hầu hết các tiểu bang đều cung cấp **quyền miễn thuế nhà ở (homestead exemption)** làm giảm giá trị chịu thuế của nơi cư trú chính của bạn, và mọi tiểu bang đều có quy trình **khiếu nại định giá** chính thức.

segments.src: Some states also cap how fast assessed value can rise — California's Proposition 13 limits the increase to 2% per year until the property sells, at which point it's reassessed at market value.
segments.tr: Một số tiểu bang cũng giới hạn mức tăng giá trị định giá — Dự luật 13 của California giới hạn mức tăng ở mức 2% mỗi năm cho đến khi bất động sản được bán, tại thời điểm đó nó được định giá lại theo giá trị thị trường.

segments.src: **2) The one-time bill — capital gains tax (the "transfer tax").** When you sell, you're taxed on the *gain*, not the sale price:
segments.tr: **2) Hóa đơn một lần — thuế thặng dư vốn ("thuế chuyển nhượng").** Khi bạn bán, bạn bị đánh thuế trên phần *lãi*, chứ không phải giá bán:

segments.src: gain = amount realized (sale price − selling costs) − adjusted basis
segments.tr: gain = amount realized (sale price − selling costs) − adjusted basis

segments.src: adjusted basis = purchase price + capital improvements − depreciation taken
segments.tr: adjusted basis = purchase price + capital improvements − depreciation taken

segments.src: Hold longer than one year and the gain gets **long-term capital gains** rates (0%, 15%, or 20% federally, depending on income), plus a possible 3.8% Net Investment Income Tax at higher incomes, plus state tax.
segments.tr: Giữ lâu hơn một năm và khoản lãi sẽ chịu thuế suất **thặng dư vốn dài hạn** (0%, 15% hoặc 20% liên bang, tùy thuộc vào thu nhập), cộng thêm khả năng 3,8% Thuế Thu nhập Đầu tư Ròng ở mức thu nhập cao hơn, cộng với thuế tiểu bang.

segments.src: Sell within a year and it's taxed as ordinary income — a materially worse outcome.
segments.tr: Bán trong vòng một năm và nó bị đánh thuế như thu nhập thông thường — một kết quả tệ hơn đáng kể.

segments.src: **The wrinkle that surprises everyone: depreciation recapture.** While you own a rental, the IRS lets you deduct the *building* (never the land) over **27.5 years** for residential property or **39 years** for commercial — a paper expense that shelters real cash income.
segments.tr: **Vấn đề khiến mọi người bất ngờ: thu hồi khấu hao.** Trong khi bạn sở hữu một tài sản cho thuê, IRS cho phép bạn khấu trừ *tòa nhà* (không bao giờ là đất) trong **27,5 năm** đối với bất động sản nhà ở hoặc **39 năm** đối với thương mại — một chi phí trên giấy tờ giúp che chở thu nhập tiền mặt thực tế.

segments.src: But at sale, the depreciation you took gets pulled back into the gain as *unrecaptured Section 1250 gain*, taxed at up to 25%.
segments.tr: Nhưng khi bán, khoản khấu hao bạn đã nhận được sẽ được kéo lại vào khoản lãi dưới dạng *lãi Mục 1250 chưa thu hồi*, bị đánh thuế lên tới 25%.

segments.src: Depreciation is a deferral, not a gift.
segments.tr: Khấu hao là sự trì hoãn, không phải là một món quà.

segments.src: And here's the trap: the IRS computes recapture on depreciation "allowed or allowable" — you owe it whether or not you actually claimed the deduction.
segments.tr: Và đây là cái bẫy: IRS tính toán việc thu hồi khấu hao đối với khoản khấu hao "được phép hoặc cho phép" — bạn nợ nó cho dù bạn có thực sự yêu cầu khấu trừ hay không.

segments.src: Three legal off-ramps are worth knowing by name:
segments.tr: Ba lối thoát pháp lý đáng biết theo tên gọi:

segments.src: - **Section 121 exclusion** — sell your *primary residence* after living in it 2 of the last 5 years and exclude up to **$250,000** of gain (single) or **$500,000** (married filing jointly).
segments.tr: - **Miễn trừ Mục 121** — bán *nơi cư trú chính* của bạn sau khi sống ở đó 2 trong số 5 năm qua và loại trừ tối đa **250.000 đô la** tiền lãi (độc thân) hoặc **500.000 đô la** (đã kết hôn khai thuế chung).

segments.src: - **Section 1031 like-kind exchange** — on *investment* property, roll the proceeds into another investment property and defer the gain. Strict clock: identify replacement property within **45 days**, close within **180 days**, and a qualified intermediary must hold the money. Since 2018 this applies to real property only.
segments.tr: - **Giao dịch cùng loại theo Mục 1031** — đối với bất động sản *đầu tư*, chuyển tiền thu được sang bất động sản đầu tư khác và hoãn khoản lãi. Đồng hồ nghiêm ngặt: xác định tài sản thay thế trong vòng **45 ngày**, đóng trong vòng **180 ngày**, và một bên trung gian đủ điều kiện phải giữ tiền. Kể từ năm 2018, điều này chỉ áp dụng cho bất động sản.

segments.src: - **Step-up in basis at death** — heirs generally inherit at fair market value, which can erase decades of embedded gain.
segments.tr: - **Nâng cơ sở khi qua đời** — những người thừa kế thường thừa kế theo giá trị hợp lý thị trường, có thể xóa sổ nhiều thập kỷ lãi tích lũy.

segments.src: Say you buy a single-family rental in Columbus, Ohio for **$300,000**.
segments.tr: Giả sử bạn mua một căn nhà cho thuê gia đình đơn lẻ ở Columbus, Ohio với giá **300.000 đô la**.

segments.src: The county allocates $60,000 to land and $240,000 to the building.
segments.tr: Quận phân bổ 60.000 đô la cho đất và 240.000 đô la cho tòa nhà.

segments.src: 1. Property management protects NOI day to day; asset management decides when to hold, improve, refinance, or sell.
segments.tr: 1. Quản lý bất động sản bảo vệ NOI hàng ngày; quản lý tài sản quyết định thời điểm giữ, cải thiện, tái tài trợ hoặc bán.

segments.src: 2. Property tax is local, annual, and permanent — effective rates range from under 0.5% to over 2% of value, so the *location* of a purchase is also a tax decision.
segments.tr: 2. Thuế tài sản là thuế địa phương, hàng năm và vĩnh viễn — tỷ lệ hiệu quả dao động từ dưới 0,5% đến hơn 2% giá trị, vì vậy *vị trí* của một giao dịch mua cũng là một quyết định thuế.

segments.src: 3. Capital gains tax is computed on gain over adjusted basis, and depreciation lowers that basis — so the deduction you enjoy while holding is largely a deferral you settle at sale.
segments.tr: 3. Thuế thặng dư vốn được tính trên khoản lãi vượt quá cơ sở điều chỉnh, và khấu hao làm giảm cơ sở đó — vì vậy khoản khấu trừ bạn được hưởng trong thời gian nắm giữ phần lớn là sự trì hoãn bạn thanh toán khi bán.

segments.src: - **NOI (Net Operating Income)** — Effective gross income minus operating expenses, before financing and depreciation; the standard measure of a property's earning power.
segments.tr: - **NOI (Thu nhập Vận hành Ròng)** — Tổng thu nhập gộp trừ đi chi phí vận hành, trước khi tài trợ và khấu hao; thước đo chuẩn về sức mạnh kiếm tiền của bất động sản.

segments.src: - **Assessed value / mill rate** — The value a local assessor assigns to a property, and the tax rate applied to it, quoted as dollars per $1,000 of value.
segments.tr: - **Giá trị định giá / tỷ lệ mill** — Giá trị mà một thẩm định viên địa phương gán cho một bất động sản và thuế suất áp dụng cho nó, được trích dẫn bằng đô la trên mỗi 1.000 đô la giá trị.

segments.src: - **Adjusted basis** — Purchase price plus capital improvements minus depreciation taken; the number your sale proceeds are measured against to compute gain.
segments.tr: - **Cơ sở điều chỉnh** — Giá mua cộng với cải tiến vốn trừ đi khấu hao đã thực hiện; con số mà tiền bán của bạn được đo lường để tính lãi.

segments.src: - **Depreciation recapture (unrecaptured §1250 gain)** — The portion of gain attributable to depreciation you previously deducted, taxed at up to 25% at sale.
segments.tr: - **Thu hồi khấu hao (lãi §1250 chưa thu hồi)** — Phần lãi do khấu hao mà bạn đã khấu trừ trước đó, bị đánh thuế lên tới 25% khi bán.

segments.src: - **Section 1031 exchange** — A swap of one investment property for another that defers capital gains tax, subject to 45-day identification and 180-day closing deadlines.
segments.tr: - **Giao dịch Mục 1031** — Việc đổi một tài sản đầu tư lấy một tài sản khác nhằm hoãn thuế thặng dư vốn, tuân theo thời hạn xác định 45 ngày và đóng cửa 180 ngày.
